protocol.common_nominal_reference_definition: When enabled, the reference is solved once from the shared zero-disturbance task sequence; it never uses seed-specific future disturbances.
protocol.selection_rule: Rank all-valid candidates by paired saving on development seeds; report finalists only on disjoint holdout seeds.
protocol.validity_rule: terminal SOC error <= 0.01, traction shortage <= 1 W, proxy violations <= 1 W/rpm
protocol.baseline: Unchanged same-seed realistic dynamic OOL baseline
